name: Improved Quality
summary: In northern Feralas, Pratt McGrubben wants tougher yeti hides from Rage Scar Hold. He asks you to bring ten to Feathermoon Stronghold.

sections.title: A Tougher Throng of Yetis
sections.body: After The Mark of Quality, Pratt McGrubben has found finer hides. A tougher throng of yetis lives inside Rage Scar Hold in northern Feralas. Bring ten hides to Pratt at Feathermoon Stronghold, and he will pay handsomely. If these hides match the Feral Scar hides, they may prove as resilient as thorium.

sections.title: Pratt's Thanks
sections.body: The Rage Scar hides are better than Pratt McGrubben hoped. He can tell they will grow much harder once properly cured. In thanks, he gives you one of his latest creations.

faq.q: Who asks for the Rage Scar yeti hides?
faq.answer: Pratt McGrubben asks you for Rage Scar yeti hides at Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas.

faq.q: Where do the Rage Scar yetis live?
aliases: where to get rage scar hides
faq.answer: The Rage Scar yetis live inside Rage Scar Hold in northern Feralas.
Pratt McGrubben wants ten Rage Scar yeti hides.

aliases: what quest leads to improved quality
faq.answer: This follows The Mark of Quality, when you dealt with the first throng of yetis.
